quarterly_data.quarter: HFCL earnings presentation: Q1 FY27 Earnings Presentation (07-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Earnings presentation: HFCL says it supplies a majority of hyperscalers and a majority of global Tier 1 telecom customers; hyperscaler, AI and data-centre demand is driving demand for its high-fiber-count cables; Passive Connectivity & Data Center Solutions is emerging as a high-growth adjacency to the OFC business, driven by exports and hyperscalers / data centers; strategy includes high-end optical fiber cable and interconnect solutions customised for hyperscalers. HFCL describes itself as the #1 optical fibre cable supplier in India; hollow core optical fiber is a new product under development.
